title: UI-V2 owner-first experience + audit fixes: VN shell, governed NL intake, owner cockpit, ObjectiveDetail tabs, stale-scope guards, manual:true, typed failure reasons
description: Owner-first V2 UX on base ab0fccf. Governed NL intake: POST /api/v1/intake/draft returns a bounded deterministic draft + advisory semantic evidence (plannerRunId:null → never pinned to a run; provider failure/malformed payload → typed unavailable + manual draft; internals never echoed; only NotFoundError → 404). Commits ONLY via canonical seams — objective → POST /api/vnext/objectives (dedup_key); mission → /app/missions/new?goal= preview/confirm. Provenance per field, explicit confirm, business required, analyze→confirm business drift blocks commit, manual:true skips analyzer, malformed numerics blocked. draft.workstreams is suggestion-only — never persisted, never auto-creates work; copy + confirm dialog + mission handoff state this; e2e proves analyze issues zero canonical writes. Shell: VN owner nav + Nâng cao disclosure, all legacy routes preserved, dark/light, mobile rail/drawer. Home: canonical aggregates only, scoped reads reset+abort-guarded per business switch, honest —/…/N+ states. ObjectiveDetail: all sections under owner tabs via ?tab= deep links. Audit findings fixed: Home stale-scope race, Intake scope drift + manual honesty + noAuthPrompt + busy + stale banner + malformed analysis + param loss. Evidence: BASE-vs-HEAD Playwright comparison (22 fail-both identical signatures, 0 regression) + real screenshots under docs/ui-v2/evidence/. E2E: ui-v2 11/11; objectives+company+inbox-ceo 68/68. Known env baseline: no qualified planner route → preview/mkMission 409 FAIL_CLOSED_PLANNER_NO_ELIGIBLE (identical at BASE).
